fields.desc:
Fabric mod id: a lower-case letter, then 1 to 63 of `a-z`, `0-9`, `_` and `-`
(`^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{1,63}$`; mcdoc checks the length, the plugin validator the pattern).
Mod version, preferably semantic (`1.0.0`).
Display name.
One-line description.
Author names.
Licence identifier, such as `MIT`; written as Fabric's `license`.
What the action does.

values.desc: Runs a data pack function at the event position.
Spawns particles at the block centre or the player's position.
Places a block state relative to the event block.
Gives the player an item; does nothing without a player.
Plays a sound at the event position.
Runs another event of the same definition.
Triggers a GeckoLib animation on the event's entity (entity definitions only; ADR 0028 D4).
Calls a script handler defined with `msm.actions.define` (ADR 0032 D4).
Gives a vanilla mob effect to the player or the other entity of the event (ADR 0044 D2).
Pushes the player or the other entity of the event (ADR 0052).
Hurts the player or the other entity of the event with magic damage (ADR 0055 D4).
Heals the player or the other entity of the event (ADR 0055 D4).

values.desc:
The event's player; in an entity definition without a player, the entity itself; in an
effect definition, the holder; in a throwable's hit event, the thrower.

The other entity of the event: the mob an entity hits (`on_attack`), the player who
hurts or interacts with an entity; for block and item events, the player; in an effect
definition, the holder; in a throwable's hit event, the living entity hit.
